title: LifecycleState
description: Complete authoritative persisted state of an organism across lifecycle simulation ticks

simulation_seed.description: 64-bit deterministic hexadecimal seed assigned at birth

chronological_age_ticks.description: Total lifetime simulation ticks elapsed since oviposition

stage_age_ticks.description: Ticks spent continuously within the current lifecycle stage

is_alive.description: Whether the organism is currently living and executing lifecycle ticks

current_stage_id.description: Active lifecycle stage (e.g., STAGE_EGG, STAGE_LARVA, STAGE_PUPA, STAGE_ADULT)

current_substage_id.description: Active substage/instar identifier if configured by species profile

developmental_state.description: Nested developmental realization state (eta, progress, locking status)

nutrition_state.description: Nested physiological reserves (energy, structural biomass, hydration, starvation)

environment_state.description: Deterministic snapshot of local ambient conditions for the current tick

stress_state.description: Multi-factorial acute and chronic physiological stress metrics

senescence_metabolic_modifier.description: Physiological age multiplier elevating metabolic demand in elder adults

active_stamina.description: Immediate stamina reserve available for action execution

death_record.description: Terminal immutable death record sealed when status is DEAD; null while ALIVE
